info.name: Process Street Public Attachments File Uploads API

items.docs: Returns a single-use upload URL and a `fileUploadId`. Upload the file's bytes to `uploadUrl` with an HTTP `PUT` (sending the same `Content-Type` you declared), then attach the upload to a target by passing the `fileUploadId` to one of the `/upload` endpoints. Lets you upload large files without sending them through the API.
